ValidationRule.description: Rule to warn agents to assign a queue to the case before putting the case on hold.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'Risk' && RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'Complaint' && RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'Chargebacks' && RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'EnterpriseAccountManagement' && SC_Team__c <> 'Partner Technology' && SC_Team__c <> 'Partnerships' && SC_Team__c <> 'KYC' && ISBLANK(SC_LatestQueueId__c) && LEFT(OwnerId,3) ='005' && ISCHANGED(Status) && CONTAINS(TEXT(Status), 'On Hold') && NOT($Permission.SC_BypassValidationRules)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please assign a queue to the case before putting the status on hold.
